title: The Goths in the Fourth Century
abstract:
This volume brings together many important historical texts, the majority of them (speeches of Themistius, the Passion of St Saba, and evidence relating to the life and work of Ulfila) not previously available in English translation. ...a compact and exciting do-it-yourself kit for the student of Gothic history... outstanding.
Bryn Mawr Classical Review
